item.title: CVE-2026-128130 [CVSS:4.0 8.3 HIGH]
item.description:
AIOHTTP is an asynchronous HTTP client/server framework for asyncio and Python. Prior to 3.14.4, when the pipelined request queue is full, the pure-Python parser stores the unparsed remainder internally and also returns the same data to its caller. After a handler declines an upgrade request, the caller feeds the remainder back to the parser, causing the buffer to grow with each handled request and dispatching already-handled requests to the application again. The issue affects deployments using AIOHTTP_NO_EXTENSIONS or otherwise running without the standard C-extension wheel, and can cause excessive memory use and repeated request processing. This issue is fixed in version 3.14.4.
Score: 8.3 (HIGH) Vector: CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:P/PR:N/UI:N/VC:N/VI:L/VA:H/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N/E:X/CR:X/IR:X/AR:X/MAV:X/MAC:X/MAT:X/MPR:X/MUI:X/MVC:X/MVI:X/MVA:X/MSC:X/MSI:X/MSA:X/S:X/AU:X/R:X/V:X/RE:X/U:X

item.title: CVE-2026-102925 [CVSS:3.1 7.8 HIGH]
item.description:
virtualenv is a tool for creating isolated virtual python environments. Prior to 21.7.13, the generated activate (bash and zsh) and activate.fish scripts place values already escaped by shlex.quote inside an additional quoted context. In the bash and zsh script, a crafted virtual environment path reaches __VIRTUAL_ENV__ when a relocated environment's recorded directory is absent; in the fish script, crafted Tcl or Tk library paths reach __TCL_LIBRARY__ or __TK_LIBRARY__. The surplus quotes can terminate the data-only quoted run and leave shell metacharacters parsed as commands when a user sources the activation script, allowing code execution with that user's privileges. This issue is fixed in version 21.7.13.
Score: 7.8 (HIGH) Vector: CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H

item.title: CVE-2026-129984 [CVSS:3.1 4.3 MEDIUM]
item.description:
AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. In versions 0.6.67 to 0.11.2, organization and team billing-manager roles intended only for spend management are treated as ordinary members across workflow, run, library, and marketplace routes. Although the role matrix in autogpt_platform/autogpt_libs/autogpt_libs/auth/permissions.py withholds run access and workflow creation, those routes do not enforce the matrix and their underlying membership lookups ignore the caller's role. As a result, a team billing manager can read team workflows and other members' runs (including inputs, outputs, and per-node data), while an organization billing manager can view shared workflows and runs and create workflows and marketplace listings; neither can modify or delete other members' workflows. This issue is fixed in version 0.11.3.
Score: 4.3 (MEDIUM) Vector: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N
